# Hacker News

> > Social news website focusing on computer science, entrepreneurship, and technology, operated by Y Combinator.

Hacker News is a community-driven platform where users submit, vote on, and discuss stories about technology, startups, programming, and science. The site features active discussions on topics ranging from product reviews and hardware to policy debates and historical tech archives.

## Key Topics

- Y Combinator
- Startup launches and entrepreneurship
- Technology news and discussion
- Product reviews and hardware
- Mechanical keyboards and peripherals
- Programming and computer science
- Tech policy and regulation
- Historical tech archives
- Community-driven content
- Software development
- App Store and platform policies
- Open source projects
- Tech industry analysis

## Core Pages

- [Hacker News Homepage](https://news.ycombinator.com/): Main page featuring top-voted technology stories, startup news, and community discussions

## Community Discussions

- [Amazon Basics Keyboard Discussion](https://news.ycombinator.com/item): Community discussion on Nick Janetakis' review of the Amazon Basics Keyboard with MX Clear switches

## Optional

- [Historical Front Page Archive (2026-03-12)](https://news.ycombinator.com/front?day=&birth=manx): Archived snapshot of the Hacker News front page from March 12, 2026
